Welcome to HOUSING with Alex Morgan!

We share educational updates on U.S. taxes, IRS news, Social Security, retirement, Medicare, and government programs affecting Americans.

⚠️ Disclaimer: This channel may use AI-generated presenters. We strive to provide accurate, fact-checked information for educational purposes only. We are not affiliated with the IRS, SSA, or any U.S. government agency. Please verify information through official sources such as IRS.gov and SSA.gov. This is an independent informational channel and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any U.S. government agency. Content is for general educational purposes only and is not professional tax, legal, or financial advice. Rules and benefits may change, so please verify details with official government sources or qualified professionals.

We aim to respect copyright, privacy, and YouTube’s Community Guidelines while providing responsible, informative content.
